source.title: Announcement of the WAC Leader
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Council Leader. Daniel Sheppard has been appointed as the Leader of the WCA Advisory Council (WAC).


Daniel was selected by the WCA Board, in accordance with Section 4.1 of our [Motion 20.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.0%20-%20Councils.pdf) about WCA Councils.


We wish Daniel the best of luck in fulfilling his new role!


Daniel Sheppard was among the three applicants who applied and his candidacy document (and the others) can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VLIht0B_vtYiUTRwJJ3sRTU3ozljSekG) if you are interested in viewing them.

translation.title: WCA 顾问理事会负责人任命公告
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Daniel Sheppard 已获任命，担任 WCA 顾问理事会（WAC）负责人。

WCA 董事会根据关于 WCA 理事会的 [20.2019.0 号议案](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2019.0%20-%20Councils.pdf)第 4.1 节，选定 Daniel。

祝 Daniel 履新顺利！

本次共有三位申请人，Daniel Sheppard 是其中之一。如有兴趣，可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VLIht0B_vtYiUTRwJJ3sRTU3ozljSekG)查看他及其他申请人的材料。
